intro: This page covers LAS’s official Long Term garages and Economy lots at Terminal 1 and Terminal 3, Short Term, Valet, and the Remote Lot on Gilespie Street, with rates copied from the official Harry Reid parking pages on November 23, 2026. Every official option is open 24 hours; the cheapest are the Economy lots and the Remote Lot at a $14 daily maximum, and Terminal 3 Long Term drops to $16 a day Saturday–Wednesday when you reserve ahead. LAS has very few independent off-airport shuttle lots with their own websites, so the eight off-airport options below are hotels whose official pages describe a park-and-fly package, paid or long-term parking, or airport parking — four with a named package (Best Western Harry Reid Inn, DoubleTree Las Vegas Airport, and two Marriott hotels in Henderson). This is a sample, not every lot near the airport. Shuttle hours are rarely published, so check before an early or late flight. Rates are dated snapshots, not live quotes.

officialLots.name: Terminal 1 Long Term Garage
officialLots.area: Garage immediately adjacent to Terminal 1, Levels 1M and 3–6 (A, B, C and D gates)

hours.notes: LAS’s main parking page says its parking facilities are open 24 hours a day, seven days a week.

officialLots.prebookRate: Reservation rate $30 at Terminal 1, as listed on the main parking page
officialLots.rateNotes: Official rates as listed on 2026-11-23. Pre-booked parking is located in the Long Term garages. The official pages list a 15-minute drive-through grace period at no charge; long-term parking has a 30-day maximum without prior arrangement (702-261-5122).
officialLots.visitNotes: The Terminal 1 page says the Long Term garage may fill during summer and holiday peaks; when it closes, drivers are redirected to the Terminal 1 Economy lot.

officialLots.name: Terminal 3 Long Term Garage
officialLots.area: Garage immediately adjacent to Terminal 3, Levels 2–6 (international carriers and D/E gates)
officialLots.access: Walk to Terminal 3; tram to the D gates

hours.notes: LAS’s main parking page says its parking facilities are open 24 hours a day, seven days a week.

officialLots.prebookRate: Reserve & Save: $16 per day Saturday–Wednesday and $20 Thursday–Friday, reservation required (standard Terminal 3 reservation rate $23), as listed on the main parking page
officialLots.rateNotes: Official rates as listed on 2026-11-23. The main parking page says discounted Terminal 3 Long Term parking requires a reservation, availability is limited, and drive-up parking is charged at posted rates. The official pages list a 15-minute drive-through grace period at no charge; long-term parking has a 30-day maximum without prior arrangement (702-261-5122).
officialLots.visitNotes: The main parking page recommends Terminal 3 for long-term covered parking. International travelers are told to park on the east (“club”) side; domestic travelers on the west (“diamond”) side.

listings.name: Silver Sevens Hotel & Casino — paid parking with airport shuttle
listings.area: Paradise Rd, east of the Strip

hours.notes: The hotel site does not publish parking-lot hours. The posted shuttle schedule runs from 4:00 AM to 11:00 PM (see shuttle notes).

listings.shuttle: Complimentary LAS shuttle for registered hotel guests and paid parking customers, per the hotel page. The posted schedule (subject to change) leaves the hotel hourly from 4:00 AM to 11:00 PM except 8:00 AM and 5:00 PM, and picks up at Terminal 1 Zero Level 20 minutes after each departure. Terminal 3 arrivals call 725.226.6170 for pickup.
listings.offersNotes: The hotel page says the airport shuttle is for registered hotel guests and paid parking customers. The parking price and booking method are not published on the page we checked.
listings.visitNotes: Call the hotel to set up paid parking before your trip.
listings.feeNotes: Parking price not published on the page we checked.
